row.title: A bot commit that skips CI runs the standards check itself, and a new ledger is born a CloudEvent
row.body: The weekly scout pass appended a plain JSON row to ops/research/outcomes.jsonl and committed it with [skip ci]. Evidence, observed live: on 2026-11-28 python3 -m foundation openstd --check failed on main with 'new bespoke format: ops/research/outcomes.jsonl', and that red reached every open pull request's foundation job, including #2848. The writer in foundation/research.py now emits a CloudEvents 1.0 envelope, readers take the payload from data and still accept an older plain row, and the scout workflow runs openstd --check before it commits. Verified by tests/foundation/test_research.py (a settled outcome is a CloudEvent and old rows still read) and openstd --check ok on this change.

title: A bot commit that skips CI runs the standards check itself, and a new ledger is born a CloudEvent
